'''Kolbaa''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] whose [[Kolbaa's majordomo|majordomo]] fell out of favor with them. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] was looking for someone to escort him to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Quick Exit}}</ref>
